understanding.goal_understanding: Finish the current level by navigating the grid to reach the goal gem tile marked '+', avoiding spike hazards that immediately end the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT (horizontal only), then gravity automatically carries the character in the current gravity direction until landing on a solid/support tile, reaching '+', or hitting a hazard. CLICK removes a breakable/clickable block at a specified [x,y] without moving the character, typically to open a new fall path; UNDO reverses the previous action. Spikes ('u'/'v') end the attempt on contact, while safe tiles ('o','m','w') provide landing support.
